boundary: Edge of the debris channel: the Lende Khola / Bhote Koshi valley floor that the 26 Aug 2026 debris flow filled (traced from Sentinel-2 into arrival.bin, drawn ~160 m wider than the true channel) versus the terraces and ridges above it. Settlements on the valley floor (Rasuwagadhi, Ghattekhola, Timure, Syabrubesi bazaar) were buried or swept away; settlements well above the river (Dhunche, upper Syabrubesi) were not. Onlinekhabar reports that the flood reached settlements up to ~80 m (270 ft) above river level.
